ai.title: Claude Code comparison table UI improved
ai.summary: Claude Code and Codebuff Comparison Table UI Improved (#439). `web/src/content/advanced/claude-code-comparison.mdx` updated. No action required.

eli5.text: The side-by-side feature chart that compares Codebuff and Claude Code has been made easier to read. If you looked at the comparison page, you would see the columns now use clearer color-coded labels and friendlier icons for each feature, instead of a plain grid of checkmarks. This only affects how the table looks; nothing about the tools themselves changed. It is live today.
